headline: Bitfinex Turns To A 167.2 Million Dollar Outflow From A 25.7 Million Dollar Intake
narrative: Bitfinex turned to a 167.2 million dollar outflow from a 25.7 million dollar intake. The pipe is the 24-hour change in clean holdings on the venue, excluding the exchange's own token, so a negative print is dollars leaving and a positive print is dollars arriving. Clean-asset outflow across 79 exchanges narrowed to 541.1 million dollars from 794.2 million dollars, equal to 0.2009 percent of the 269.3 billion dollars held on those venues, while Binance sent out 438.9 million dollars.
author: jordan
